[SWS_CM_00314] Call SubscriptionStateChangeHandler with kSubscribed
⌈
The
Communication Management shall call the SubscriptionStateChangeHandler
with the value kSubscribed in the following cases:
• the client subscribes to an event and the actual subscription is established suc-
cessfully
• the client is subscribed to an event and the actual subscription is re-established
again after being temporarily unavailable (due to restart, network problem or so)
⌋
